name: Good For Evil
overview: Scripture calls believers to respond to hostility with kindness, urging them to love and do good even to those who hate or persecute them, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:44-47. This radical love reflects the character of God, who graciously provides for both the just and the unjust (Matthew 5:45). The example of Abraham receiving restoration from Abimelech in Genesis 20:14 further illustrates the principle of returning good for evil, showing God's providential hand in relationships marked by grace rather than retaliation.
